title: Cross-repo Pending v1 (ADR-0030)
description: Schema for .rddf/state/.cross-repo-pending.json. Tracks Hub Issues that are blocking local design-done/plan-done gates. Emitted by add-rdd-hub-cross-repo-federation (Step 2).

version.description: Schema version. v1 introduces tracking of Hub Issue Status linking to local proposals.

expected_status.description: Hub Issue Status that will unblock local gates

blocked_gates.description: Local gates blocked by this Hub Issue

added_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this pending relationship was created

last_polled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when Hub Issue Status was last checked

pending_issues.description: List of Hub Issues blocking local workflow gates

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this file was last modified
